caption: The drawing depicts a quilt with a rectangular composition consisting of multiple geometric sections made up of various smaller patterned shapes. The quilt is divided into nine blocks arranged in a 3x3 grid. The four corner blocks feature concentric rectangles in alternating colors and patterns, with an inner red square surrounded by bands of green, pink, cream, white, brown, and purple, all decorated with floral or geometric prints. The four side center blocks each consist of a patchwork of irregularly shaped pieces in a variety of colors including red, blue, brown, yellow, orange, cream, and green, with a mix of dotted, floral, striped, and checked patterns. The central block displays a circular design with triangular segments radiating outward, resembling a sun or flower, with alternating segments of red striped and tan shapes, and an inner circle featuring a red and brown pattern on a tan background. The overall color palette is dominated by reds, blues, browns, and creams, with smaller accents of green, yellow, orange, and pink. The quilt is set against a beige background, and the name "Suzanne Roy" is written in small letters on the lower right side of the page.
title: Crib Coverlet
